description: Capability for the main window. Grants ONLY permission to execute the bundled cleanup-ui sidecar (by its registered externalBin name, sidecar-scoped, with a fixed argument list) plus Tauri's own default core permissions (window/event/webview management etc). No filesystem, no HTTP/network plugin, no shell access beyond this one named sidecar, no updater, no analytics/telemetry.
